**Severity:** error · **Area:** Imports / helpers / route modules (`RV3xxx`) · **Quick fix:** none

## Message

The diagnostic reads:

```text
Import structural helpers as named bindings; namespace aliases are not supported
```

## How to fix

Import the structural helper by name and use it as a tag: import `{ For }` from "@rivetjs/runtime/dom"; `<For each={xs}>…</For>`.

## Example

```tsx avoid nocheck
import * as r from "@rivetjs/runtime/dom";
declare const xs: any;
export const A = () => <r.For each={xs}>{(x: any) => <p>{x}</p>}</r.For>;
```

```tsx prefer
import { For } from "@rivetjs/runtime/dom";
declare const xs: any;
export const A = () => <For each={xs}>{(x: any) => <p>{x}</p>}</For>;
```

## When it is reported

Fires together with RV3002 for the same tag; RV3002's quick fix (rivetNamedImport) also rewrites the closing tag.
